# Grid

Move through two-dimensional cells, select values, and enter edit mode.

## Examples

### Selectable

Move through a grid and select the active cell.

<ComponentExample component="grid" scenario="selectable" title="Selectable" description="Move through a grid and select the active cell." :index="0" />

### Editable

Move through grid cells and edit the active value without losing two-dimensional navigation.

<ComponentExample component="grid" scenario="editable" title="Editable" description="Move through grid cells and edit the active value without losing two-dimensional navigation." :index="1" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow keys</kbd> | Move between grid cells. |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Select the current cell or row. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>F2</kbd> | Enter edit mode when the current cell supports editing. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Cancel the active edit. |

## Accessibility

The labeled grid reports row and column counts while each cell exposes position, selection, and disabled state.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/grid/) for the host accessibility contract.
